title: MemoryCore v1 goes live
content_body: Founding decision: MemoryCore is established as the canonical source of truth and memory for TerAustralis Incognita. Scope: the project's own works, decisions, corrections, and a curated external index — reads open to all humans and AI systems; writes consent-governed through the Steward. Every entry carries provenance (source, tier, status). Originals are immutable; corrections chain as child revisions; removals follow the tombstone rule (content withdrawn, record and reasons preserved). The Indigenous & Oral Knowledge and Family & Genealogy domains are consent-gated. Built 1 August 2026 with Claude in a single session, deployed on the project's own Supabase and Vercel infrastructure.

title: Absolute Anarchy — Starline Transmission
content_body: Catalogue row for the track "Absolute Anarchy" (RenIsHere / @m13crystalat), generated on Suno on 1 August 2026, pre-dawn AEST.
